# Acorns Nest

> Daycare management software for licensed childcare centres in Canada. Directors run the centre from a web dashboard; teachers, kitchen staff and parents use the iOS and Android app. Built in Halifax, Nova Scotia by Acorns Nest Inc.

## About

- Company: Acorns Nest Inc.
- Location: 5651 Ogilvie Street, Unit 411, Halifax, Nova Scotia B3H 1B9, Canada
- Founded by: Vishnu Priyan Mahendran, Vignesh Moorthy
- Launched: September 2026
- Country served: Canada
- Contact: support@acornsnest.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Atlantic Time

## What Acorns Nest does

Acorns Nest is daycare management software for licensed childcare centres. It covers:

- Attendance and check-in / check-out, with Bulk Log and Mid-day Exit and Return for appointments
- Naps started and ended for one child or the whole room, more than one nap a day, or a time staff set
- Meals, milk feeds in ounces or millilitres, and diaper checks
- Weekly menus: breakfast, lunch, evening snack, up to four saved weeks placed on the calendar
- A newsletter the director reviews, then shares with families
- Parent updates: the care log opens as it is logged, or at a time the centre sets
- Attendance reports by centre, room and child, with a spreadsheet export
- Substitute timesheets with director approval
- Outing Mode, with alerts to the families of children on the outing
- Billing, your way. Keep your own records, or turn your invoices digital with our invoice tool, at no extra cost. Or let Acorns Nest collect tuition online for you through Stripe. If you take payments through Stripe, Stripe's processing fees apply, and we'll tell you what they are before you turn it on. Each centre chooses what fits.
- AI Insights: director-facing briefings generated from the day's logs
- We don't use your centre's records to train AI models.

Directors use a web dashboard at acornsnest.com. Teachers, kitchen staff and parents use the iOS and Android apps.

## Who it is for

Licensed childcare centres in Canada: directors, teachers and early childhood educators, substitutes, kitchen staff, and the parents and guardians of enrolled children.

## How parents and staff get access

There is no public sign-up. Centres invite each parent or staff member by email with a code. They accept the invite at acornsnest.com/accept-invite, install the app, and sign in.

## Pricing

One flat plan per centre, sized by how many children you care for, with unlimited staff and family logins. Prices are not listed on the site. We're piloting with a licensed daycare centre now, and opening pilots across Atlantic Canada. Pilot centres can ask for custom work.

## Privacy

Children do not have accounts. Acorns Nest does not sell personal information and does not use it for advertising. Data is processed on the centre's instructions. We don't use your centre's records to train AI models. See https://acornsnest.com/privacy for the full policy.
